notes.title: New Update! Our demo (0.1.04) now has Full Controller Support!
notes.notes:
Now you can use your controllers in Menus as well. Have Fun & Don't forget to Wishlist HellCome! 

We rebalanced the hardness of enemies vs base stats of Characters,
We added some new skills and buffed some existing skills as well...

For the next update we are working on a New Game Mode! So Stay Tuned!!..

notes.title: New Update! Our demo (0.1.02) is now better and stronger!
notes.notes:
Hey, We heard your feedback and We are very GRATEFUL for it...
Thank you all who played our demo, who wishlisted our game and who took the time to gave us invaluable feedback.
We evaluated common gameplay feedbacks;
[list]
[*]Fixed Exp Points being unpickable.
[*]Fixed Meat Hook rope going crazy.
[*]Fixed Enemies being able to spawn very close.
[*]Changed Enemy Hardness scaling.
[/list]
Have Fun!!
